The draft reply tells Max the refund has already been made.

policy_basis.quote: A duplicate charge: refund the duplicate payment in full.
Before sharing or changing anything on an account, check that the request comes from the email address on that account
Questions about a charge that looks wrong are handled by the membership team, who can see the account.
Tax invoices for every payment are available in the member app under Account > Payment history.

final.draft_reply:
Hi Max,

Thanks for getting in touch about the double charge. We've checked your account. You're right that your November membership fee of $99 was charged twice on 14 November 2026. Under our membership team procedures (STAFF-01), a duplicate charge is refunded in full, and that has already been done. The duplicate $99 payment was refunded on 18 November 2026.

You paid only one $99 membership fee for November, so we haven't made another refund. You can see your payments and tax invoices in the member app under Account > Payment history (POL-02).

If you're seeing a different charge from 14 November that doesn't match this, please reply with its date and amount and we'll look into it.

Kind regards,
Ridgeline Membership Team

facts.fact: The duplicate charge was already refunded on 18 November

judge.reason: The reply states the duplicate $99 was refunded on 18 November 2026, which matches the records. It says no further refund is being made, so it does not promise another one. The STAFF-01 reference, the Payment history location and the $99 amounts are all supported. Inviting the member to write back about a different charge is an offer of help, not a claim to grade.
